description: Pre-execution SQL checks validate every table a query references. Each case runs the full prepare path (empty and canQuery checks, object access, references, field validation) and pins whether the query is allowed and, when refused, why.
notes: Consumed by sdk/python/tests/test_sql_multi_table.py, sdk/typescript/packages/core/tests/sql-multi-table.test.ts, sdk/typescript/packages/mcp/tests/sql-multi-table.test.ts and sdk/dotnet/tests/Tolap.Mcp.Tests/SqlMultiTableTests.cs (both .NET wrappers). Each runner asserts the case count. Where a query is refused by more than one check, the reason is the first check to refuse it: the object check on the supplied object name (or else the first FROM table), then the reference check (read under ANSI, then MySQL, then PostgreSQL lexing), then the field check.
